sourcePolicy.availability: Every feature joins through a captured snapshot whose available_at or snapshot_date is at or before the projection cutoff.

dangerTaxonomy.missingness: A missing or non-finite distance is excluded from danger-band counts, reported as missing coverage, and is never coerced to zero.

traitPolicy.rule: NHL EDGE traits may be cutoff-safe model inputs and current player-detail context; they are not additive season projections without separate longitudinal validation.

modeling.selection: Each advanced target runs a chronological baseline-versus-challenger tournament and retains its valid baseline when the challenger loses.
modeling.xg: Only an approved, versioned, calibrated in-house xG artifact may produce expected-goal targets.
modeling.assistExpectation: Expected primary and secondary assists remain separate. A shot-assist model is eligible only when candidate coverage passes the preregistered source-coverage gate; otherwise the published advanced fields fall back to the validated fantasy-v4 primary/secondary assist expectations and disclose that fallback.
modeling.aggregation: Per-game individual, on-ice, goalie, and team components aggregate over the actual remaining schedule.
modeling.reconciliation: Shot, danger, save, and expected-goal identities reconcile after model and editorial transforms.
modeling.shrinkage: Player, goalie, and team per-game rates use empirical-Bayes shrinkage toward position or league priors, with support recorded in the artifact.
modeling.context: Per-game serving adjusts rates only with schedule, opponent, team, deployment, and availability values already frozen by the v4 release.

evaluation.fallbackRule: A target that misses support, loss, calibration, or source-coverage gates serves its preregistered baseline with the failure reason visible; it is not left empty.
evaluation.consumedLockboxPolicy: The 2025-26 lockbox is not new blind evidence.

publication.dependency: A validated and published fantasy-v4 release must exist before an advanced-v5 release is eligible.
publication.fantasyScoring: Advanced outcomes may be scored only when the provider or user explicitly assigns a weight.

acceptance.sourceCoverage: Missing source rows remain missing and block an affected target freeze; they are never coerced to zero.
acceptance.determinism: Identical artifact, feature, roster, schedule, and override inputs produce byte-equivalent canonical outputs.
